personality_one_liner: A highly functional, trust-inspiring logistics and moving experience that feels as clear and reliable as a well-organized manifest.

spacing.rule: Generous padding around content; clear thumb zones with 56pt high primary CTAs anchored at the bottom.

screens.name: Role Selection & Auth
screens.purpose: Secure entry and role routing for Customers vs Delivery Partners.
screens.layout: Vertical split or card-based selection. Large 56pt buttons for 'Login as Customer' and 'Register as Partner'. Social logins positioned below.

screens.name: Customer Home
screens.purpose: Primary booking interface emphasizing location entry.

states.error: Location permission error with retry CTA

screens.layout: Map-as-hero filling the screen. A draggable `@gorhom/bottom-sheet` contains the 'Where to?' input fields (Pickup/Drop). High-contrast UI overlay for clarity.

screens.name: Item & Service Selection
screens.purpose: Capture inventory (items, weight) and service tier (Pack & Shift).

states.empty: No items selected - 'Add items to continue'

screens.layout: Progressive step. First, a grid of categories (Sofa, Fridge, Cartons) using `Phosphor` icons inside `brandTertiary` rounded squares with +/- steppers. Next, side-by-side cards comparing 'Pack & Shift' vs 'Shift-Only' with checklists. Sticky 'Continue' CTA.

screens.name: Checkout & Price Breakdown
screens.purpose: Transparent display of distance, hours, items, GST, and final price.
screens.layout: Scrollable vertical list. Invoice-style breakdown cards showing Base Fare, Distance Charge, Packing Charge, and GST (CGST/SGST/IGST). Total prominently displayed. Sticky 'Pay with Razorpay' CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: Partner Dashboard
screens.purpose: Cockpit view for delivery partners to manage open jobs and earnings.

states.empty: Illustration of driver on motorcycle - 'No active jobs near you. Check back soon.'

screens.layout: Top section shows active status and quick earnings (95% post 5% commission). Main body is a vertical list of 'Open Jobs' cards showing Pickup, Drop, and Time Window. Massive 'Accept Job' primary button on each card.

hero_moving_truck.alt: Delivery truck with moving boxes on pallet

partner_empty_state.alt: Delivery partner on motorcycle during daytime

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow '1 iOS-Native Clean' personality closely. Use generous vertical rhythms and high-contrast, highly readable UI.
Implement a Map-as-Hero layout for the Customer Home screen with '@gorhom/bottom-sheet' for location input.
Break the booking flow into progressive steps: Location -> Items (stepper grid) -> Service Tier (Pack & Shift vs Shift Only) -> Price breakdown.
Display a transparent GST invoice (Base fare, Distance, Packing, CGST, SGST) before the Razorpay payment step.
For the Partner Dashboard, ensure the 5% commission calculation is clearly shown (e.g., Gross Fare - 5% LuggEase Commission = Partner Earnings).
Use Phosphor icons with consistent weights. Generic furniture items (Sofa, Fridge) should use icons inside 'brandTertiary' rounded squares, not image placeholders.
Include a gradient scrim (top to bottom, up to 70% opacity) behind any text overlaying images.
Always wrap scrollable content with a sticky primary CTA anchored at the bottom (outside the scroll view, accounting for safe areas).
